CoreConclusion: Display the registered 2x2 graph/loss comparisons and their uncertainty, including motion-state and costly-switch evidence, without presupposing a positive scientific result.
Archetype: quantitative grid with trajectory case panels
DatasetLabel: nuScenes HeadTrain630 internal ranking OOF, 3 folds
EvaluationScope: Frozen Stage5A candidate generator; overlapping predictor training scenes; not official independent test or independent end-to-end validation

DisplayDefinitions.G: Future Interaction Graph / original frozen Stage11B G1

EvidenceChain.Purpose: The four Overall Top1FDE means occupy the registered graph-by-loss design; means have descriptive scene-cluster 95% intervals.
Display Vehicle and Pedestrian means and descriptive scene-cluster uncertainty using the same four-model ordering.
Display the moving-vehicle subgroup and paired graph/loss contrasts, explicitly exploratory.
Show architecture/loss structure, group means and the four registered paired Overall contrasts with Bonferroni-adjusted 98.75% intervals.
Show gain/harm and largest-10%-positive-harm sums for three required contrasts in Overall and MovingVehicle; tail membership and actor counts are disclosed.
Show both improvements and failures on unchanged six-candidate geometry, using GT only for post-freeze descriptive case selection and display.

StatisticalContract.Bootstrap: 2000 paired whole-scene resamples within each 210-scene fold; seed2022
StatisticalContract.ModelMeanIntervals: descriptive 95% scene-cluster intervals, not significance tests
StatisticalContract.Direction: negative delta favors the first model
StatisticalContract.Units: Top1FDE m; gross/tail harm sums m across actor-windows; count actor-windows
StatisticalContract.HighCostDefinition: largest ceil(0.1*n_positive_harms) within each contrast/group; different tails must not be described as identical paired subsets

CaseSelection.RepresentativeCases: G-C minus NG-C: select the changed-mode actor closest to the median delta among improvements and harms, separately Vehicle and Pedestrian; prefer a scene not already displayed
CaseSelection.TailCases: Additional MovingVehicle largest improvement and largest harm for G-C minus NG-C, using distinct actor identities where available
CaseSelection.MissingSubsets: report an unavailable panel explicitly; never invent a case
CaseSelection.Geometry: all six frozen candidates and separate GT/history in original t0 ego orientation; optional plot translation centers on current actor without changing stored candidates
CaseSelection.SelectedModes: display the Top1 selection of all four models and their FDE; overlaps mean the same frozen candidate was selected

ExportContract.FinalWidthsInches: 7.1 double-column quantitative figures; 7.1 trajectory case panels
ExportContract.SourceData: small CSV per quantitative family plus case identity/selection manifest; large caches remain local
ExportContract.Palette: consistent muted blue NoGraph and purple Graph; dashed SoftCE, solid Error-Aware; black GT
ExportContract.SampleSize: actual Count from identical full 12-step historical evaluation rows, shown in every figure
ExportContract.FigureLabel: dataset, internal OOF protocol, count, units, and interval definition in every figure

ReviewRisks: Do not label internal ranking OOF as independent official test.
Do not infer a graph contribution from Bicycle: all four models use the same predefined fold R2 route.
Do not equate overlapping descriptive model-mean intervals with paired contrast inference.
Do not replace the registered family4 intervals with selected significant comparisons.
Do not claim attention, causality, closed-loop safety, or trajectory geometry improvements from ranking case plots.
Disclose representative and tail case selection; figures are examples, not aggregate evidence.
No GT-guided candidate recomputation, new inference, tuning, or scientific decision is performed by plotting code.
ExecutionGate: Require all6 frozen checkpoint SHA checks, PASS unified identity audit and cache SHA checks, PASS bootstrap audit and PASS switch audit before any evaluation-array read.
